This survey was flown by EDCON-PRJ, Inc. as a sub-contractor to NV5 Geospatial under USGS Contract GPSC3 G16PC00016  and Task Order 140G0221F0024 NV Westcentral Geophysical 2020 D21. 
The GeoDAWN Project consists of high-resolution aeromagnetic and radiometric data designed to image the subsurface geology and structure of  a large portion of northern and western Nevada. These data are intended for rigorous modeling and interpretation of the geology and structure in this region and will be used to evaluate the potential for undiscovered resources and will contribute to USGS and DOE-related mineral and geothermal resource assessments of the region.
This dataset includes raw and processed magnetic and radiometric data acquired and processed by EDCON-PRJ, Inc., 6900 W. Jefferson Ave. # 150, Lakewood Colorado 80235
